description: Elections Commission - E. M. T. Banda of the Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - W. D. S. Tennakoon of the Karuwalagaswewa Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette notice declares that a member of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This directly concerns electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes matters related to electoral boundaries, candidate registrations, and declarations about elected members.
